company_name: INTERTEC SALES CORP SHANGHAI REP OFFICE
semiconductor_relevance: High — Intertec Sales Corp specializes in providing pre-owned and refurbished semiconductor manufacturing equipment and parts, making it a relevant player in the semiconductor equipment market.
summary: Intertec Sales Corp offers a wide range of affordable and reliable pre-owned semiconductor manufacturing equipment and parts. They provide refurbishment services and support for equipment relocation and removal, catering to the needs of fabs in Japan and Taiwan.
capabilities: Spare parts supply including pumps and chillers
technical_expertise: Supply chain management for semiconductor parts

regional_presence.Japan: Intertec has a headquarters in Tokyo and a refurbishment center in Kumamoto, focusing on the domestic market.
regional_presence.Taiwan: The company has connections with fabs in Taiwan, facilitating equipment sales and support.
